interface.longDescription: Starts with the harness-ultragoal:fit-repo entry contract, then routes into ultragoal contracts, harness engineering, fresh repo initialization, existing repo retrofit, agent-facing observability, product cohesion gates, macro ExecPlan lanes, orchestration, and proof gates for high-trust Codex work.
defaultPrompt: Use harness-ultragoal:fit-repo to classify this repo and install or verify the correct Harness Ultragoal setup surfaces.
Use harness-ultragoal:fit-repo before choosing init, retrofit, ultragoal, proof-gate, or product-cohesion follow-on skills.
Use harness-ultragoal:fit-repo to emit the typed fit-repo receipt and claim ceiling before setup completion claims.
Use harness-ultragoal:fit-repo to refuse unsupported install, app-registry, marketplace, runtime, or dogfood claims without same-surface proof.
Use harness-ultragoal:product-fitness-gate for product-impacting success, readiness, release, daily-driver, or material product sign-off claims; Product Cohesion alone is not Product Fitness proof.
